title: By 80, Adults Retain Only 65% Of Their Muscle
closing: Strength training can protect the independence that age-related muscle loss threatens.
question: How often do you lift?

segments.say: By 80, adults retain 65% of their age-30 muscle. That loss can weaken everyday movement.
After 70, muscle loss reaches 18% per decade, so decline accelerates when independence matters most.
After 12 weeks of lifting, clinical muscle loss fell to 0% in one study. Training can reverse the slide.
